# The Collapse of Complex Societies

**Author:** Joseph Tainter (1988)

Analysis of why complex civilizations collapse, arguing that increasing sociopolitical complexity yields diminishing returns on investment.

This book was curated in Matthew's Consilience Garden keen in 2021 as part of the "Media and Books" section — one of the thinkers who shaped the protocol's framing.
